title: Shopper Earnings Terms — Loyalty Allowance on Not-Delivered Recoveries, Cartwise Shopper Batches
content:
**Condition.** When pay for orders verified as not delivered is taken back on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the not-delivered loyalty allowance is subtracted from the not-delivered orders' share of the mileage posting once any share multiplying it has been applied, and the amount is never below zero. The allowance is:

(a) **0.40** for a shopper account at the Gold level or above (Full-Service Shopper Gold, Platinum or Diamond in Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts) that is **36 or more** whole calendar months past its first activation date;

(b) **0.20** for an account at the Silver level or above (Silver, Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **12 to 35** whole calendar months past its first activation date;

(c) **nothing** for every other account.

The level and the first activation date are read from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record, the months counted in whole calendar months up to the handling date.

## Combinations

| Level | Whole months since first activation | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 36 or more | 0.40 |
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 12 to 35 | 0.20 |
| Silver | 12 to 35 | 0.20 |
| Silver | 36 or more | Nothing |
| Any | Fewer than 12 | Nothing |
| Shop-Only Shopper or Full-Service Shopper | Any | Nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Gold account 44 months past activation, share after multiplication 1.50: 1.50 less 0.40 leaves 1.10.
- A Silver account 18 months past activation, share after multiplication 0.15: 0.15 less 0.20 would be negative, so 0.00.
